title: Beneficial ownership: tracing who is behind a shell company
summary: In 2024, TD Bank pleaded guilty to $18.3 trillion in unmonitored transaction activity tied to money laundering.
body_markdown:
A beneficial owner is the real human who controls or profits from a company, even if their name never appears on the formation documents. Shell companies exist specifically to hide this person from regulators and investigators.


Minutes. Work that used to take a compliance analyst a full week of manual pivoting across corporate registries and breach dumps now runs in parallel and returns a connected graph.


Two major ones: multiple LLCs registered to the same agent address within a short window, and a completely clean digital footprint on a newly formed entity. Real people show up in breach records. Synthetic identities almost never do.


FinCEN now requires companies to self-report beneficial owners. Our agents verify those disclosures against live data and flag mismatches before they become a compliance liability.
